en.title: Follows the section in view
en.desc: Scroll the text on the right or pick a link: the ink slides to the section nearest the top of the window.
en.html:
Introduction Requirements Service hours Terms

Introduction

The micro business permit covers registration, document checks, a site survey and issuing the permit within fourteen working days.

Requirements

The owner's KTP, a business domicile letter and a photo of the premises. Incomplete files are returned within 2 working days.

Service hours

Tuesdays 13:00 to 15:00 at counter 2, ground floor, or by appointment.

Terms

One application per business premises, unless the guide says otherwise.

id.html:
Pendahuluan Persyaratan Jam layanan Ketentuan

Pendahuluan

Izin usaha mikro mencakup pendaftaran, verifikasi dokumen, survei lokasi, dan penerbitan izin dalam empat belas hari kerja.

Persyaratan

KTP pemilik, surat keterangan domisili usaha, dan foto tempat usaha. Berkas yang kurang dikembalikan dalam 2 hari kerja.

Jam layanan

Selasa 13.00 sampai 15.00 di loket 2, lantai dasar, atau dengan janji temu.

Ketentuan

Satu permohonan untuk satu tempat usaha, kecuali panduan menyebutkan lain.
